A working research platform; explicit limits

VascuAI brings coronary CT ingestion, segmentation, evaluation and source-bound research review into one application. The engineering problem is to make large three-dimensional images, model outputs and human preparation records traceable, usable and access-controlled without implying that every visible result is a validated medical finding.

Artery segmentation identifies vessel foreground voxels. Stenosis assessment is a different task: a lesion must be located, its measurement method and reference supported, and its interpretation verified. A segmentation probability is neither a stenosis probability nor calibrated clinical confidence.

The developed solution uses a React workspace and FastAPI API, PostgreSQL for relational evidence, and private file storage for original volumes and artifacts. Two segmentation approaches have been compared on the same 50 Validation cases. Separate experimental profile procedures and a blinded reviewer workflow support research preparation.

Evidence boundary. No qualified expert lesion ground truth is available. There is no trained stenosis classifier, validated severity model or genuine stenosis Grad-CAM. Both release authorization flags remain false. Latest reviewer/research changes are local and undeployed, including the new third-reader CT pane.

What this individual record establishes

  • Describes source and observed tests, not a substitute for clinical evaluation or mentor sign-off.
  • Separates committed history, pending local implementation and historical staging verification.
  • Records actual development problems and their supported causes; unresolved hypotheses remain unresolved.
  • Attributes model metrics to the verified saved cohort and tests to named execution logs.

Base source identity: e37b7c87eebe5099686687eacd6a6db897d2e6c7. This HTML/PDF also describes pending changes in the review worktree; it is not a release tag.

MILESTONE 1

M1 â€” Foundations and identity

The initial objective was a coherent coronary CTA research workflow: authenticate a user, create a patient/case, ingest a genuine three-dimensional volume, inspect its metadata and retain the source association for later analysis. PostgreSQL models keep users, patients, cases, audit events and run evidence relational instead of relying on UI-only state.

Authentication and role enforcement

Identity / roleActual behavior
JWTSigned HS256 tokens with issuer/audience, expiration and token-version checks. Current account state is rechecked; logout revokes the active token generation. Passwords use Argon2 hashing.
Clinician / AdminExisting clinical-workspace writers: create/update cases and request segmentation subject to source/runtime checks.
Researcher / DataScientistExisting role-based case reading. DataScientist/Admin can import offline evaluations. User administration is Admin-only.
Assigned reviewerGlobal allowlist further restricts even a valid account to its own CT-only review workflow. Changing a role does not bypass assignment restrictions.

Session restoration distinguishes a temporary API failure from an invalid session. Delayed responses are bound to the initiating token/user generation, so logout or account changes cannot restore another sessionâ€™s state. The server remains authoritative: hiding a button is not authorization.

Patient and case workflow

  • Create a de-identified patient record and associate a case through its actual database key. Dataset IDs are separate identifiers.
  • Validate form/API inputs, persist the transaction, then retrieve the authoritative record.
  • Case status and a manual workflow review do not imply a clinically confirmed stenosis finding.
  • Uploads, reports and model histories are authenticated; internal storage paths are excluded from allowlisted exports.
The prototypeâ€™s general case-read policy is role-based; it is not a new patient-consent or institution-level authorization platform. Blinded study access is separately owner/assignment-bound.

[SRC] auth/patient/case routers, roles.py, AuthContext.jsx, cases-contract.js and authorization regression tests. Current wireframes are reconstructed as-implemented documentation, not recovered historical Week 1 originals.

Original CT ingestion and visualization

Ingestion checks compressed, expanded and voxel budgets rather than trusting a filename. Decoding and rendering have separate limits: an accepted server file need not fit a browser GPU. Source bytes and medical headers are retained. The frontend verifies the original CT identity before using landmarks or model overlays.

Geometry is more than matching dimensions

A native voxel coordinate maps to RAS millimetres by x = A Â· [i, j, k, 1]áµ€. Landmark capture uses the full inverse affine, not only axis-wise spacing. The shared validator rejects nonfinite, singular, unsupported or mismatched geometry across capture, restore and export. Native IJK remains the stored coordinate frame.

Unsupported oblique/sheared browser geometries remain refused. An explicit verified-download/manual-IJK fallback supports preparation in a suitable external viewer without raising display caps. The fallback is withheld after checksum/geometry integrity failures.

CT spatial units are known in mm in the saved protocol. The original reference-mask spatial units remain unresolved. Equal numeric shape/affine is not independently verified anatomical registration. Reference annotations are never relabelled as model predictions.

[SRC] volume validation, source_fingerprint.py, NIfTI decode/worker, ct-review-loader.js, annotation-draft.js and NiiVue adapters. Tests cover flips/permutations, native coordinates, stale sessions, invalid affines and safe resource refusal.

MILESTONE 2

M2 â€” Data and model implementation

Dataset and separation

The selected modality is coronary CTA. SegResNetâ€™s saved run uses 200 Split-4 Training cases (401â€“600) and 50 Validation cases (851â€“900). The 250 held-out Testing cases were not used for this development. Validation participated in checkpoint selection, so it is not an untouched test cohort.

Original ImageCAS CT and ImageCAS-X annotations have distinct attribution/licensing boundaries. The recorded original CT use is non-commercial research under CC BY-NC 4.0; separately supplied ImageCAS-X annotations carry CC BY 4.0 attribution. Annotation availability does not expand CT redistribution rights. This document includes no dataset images or model weights.

SmallUNet3D â€” checkpoint-compatible baseline

The actual module uses base width 8, two 3D convolution/BatchNorm/ReLU blocks per stage, two max-pooling levels, a 32-channel bottleneck, transposed-convolution upsampling and skip concatenations. A one-channel output produces logits and sigmoid probabilities. The saved historical step-700 artifact is retained; the label is not a verified optimizer count or recovered original run identity.

MONAI SegResNet â€” advanced segmentation

The frozen recipe uses spatial_dims=3, init_filters=16, one input channel, two output channels, down blocks [1,2,2,4], up blocks [1,1,1] and deconvolution upsampling. Its 4,744,034 parameters are checked by the optional serving module. Checkpoint loading verifies an explicit SHA-256 and known metadata; there is no silent architecture detection or unsafe general pickle fallback.

[SRC] segmentation/model.py, inference.py, segresnet.py; external training provenance and verified saved outputs. SmallUNet3D is a segmentation model, not a stenosis classifier.

Metric definitions

Dice = 2TP / (2TP + FP + FN)
IoU = TP / (TP + FP + FN)
Precision = TP / (TP + FP)
Recall = TP / (TP + FN)

Headline macro values are unweighted means across defined included cases. Each metric retains its own denominator; zero denominators produce null and an explicit convention, not an invented zero. Pooled micro values sum confusion counts first, then evaluate the ratio. Cases with exclusions are not silently converted into successful measurements.

The comparison verifier checks exact case membership, source/reference/prediction hashes, shapes, numeric native grids and recomputed counts. All 100 prediction files and unchanged references were checked; 53 comparison artifact hashes matched on reproducibility replay. Two historical baseline cases were reused with their frozen evidence rather than recomputed under a new protocol.

This is a same-cohort, heterogeneous-protocol comparison. Architecture, training exposure, input resolution and threshold differ; higher Dice cannot be attributed to architecture alone. No clinical validation, calibrated confidence or independent held-out Testing performance is established.

[CMP] COMPARISON.json, PER-CASE-COMPARISON.csv, FINAL-COMPARISON-INTEGRITY.json and COMPARISON-REPRODUCIBILITY.json.

MILESTONE 3

M3 â€” Source-bound candidate research

The implemented research subset starts with a supplied, authorized artery mask and explicitly ordered branches. It samples perpendicular cross-sections along the branch, checks source membership and contiguous support, and exposes potential narrowing regions as experimental candidates. It is not a validated detector.

Sampling and mathematics

Native affine geometry maps plane locations into the original mask. Categorical sampling uses nearest neighbour. The selected plane component uses 8-connectivity and must contain the centerline point. Background-at-center, boundary contact, insufficient references or excluded junction neighbourhoods produce abstention. Other components are not merged; morphology is not introduced.

A = selected foreground pixel count Ã— plane pixel area
Deq = 2 âˆš(A / Ï€)

Area-equivalent diameter is a diagnostic cross-section summary, not a calibrated minimum lumen diameter. R1 uses bidirectional median support with interpolation; R2 uses the smaller directional mean. Both share the same source profile and inclusive area-trigger parameters, so their errors and evidence are not statistically independent.

[SRC] experimental_candidates.py, research-assessment.js. Endpoints, reference windows, minimum support and contiguous intervals remain explicit; branch ordering is never assumed to identify anatomical proximal/distal direction.

Bounded native processing and browser import

Typical original masks exceed the original small browser-preview budget. The supported offline path avoids allocating a complete decompressed mask array: it snapshots a bounded native uint8 NIfTI, maps storage, hashes canonical labels in slabs, tracks bounded connectivity frontiers and gathers only required plane samples. It does not resample to a coarser grid merely to manufacture success.

Native volume134,217,728 voxel cap; explicit uint8 unscaled mask and coded CT mm geometry.

EvidenceAt most 2 MiB JSON; all branches, parameters, samples, candidates and implementation/version identities retained.
Original browser previewOriginal 4-million-mask-voxel limit remains unchanged. Optional CT rendering keeps its existing geometry/GPU limits.
API verificationCurrent case/run resolves actual stored CT/mask. Server recomputes every field; mismatched or unsupported evidence is refused.
ConcurrencyOne verification per API process; optional runtime/busy/storage failures are explicit 503. No global rate limit or hard kernel CPU deadline is claimed.

A prior native synthetic demonstration processed 4,276,737 voxels twice with identical profile identity; peak observed process-tree RSS was 82,345,984 bytes. That is periodic observation, not a kernel-enforced memory cap. New integration tests use smaller synthetic stored files. Neither demonstration establishes whole-dataset performance.

TECHNICAL RECORD

Automatic centerlines â€” precise remaining limits

The existing Lee skeleton is not assumed to be a valid branch graph. The research extractor checks 6/26-connectivity, boundary contact and Euler topology; retains the raw 26-neighbour graph; rejects cycles/adjacent junction clusters; partitions every edge and vertex; and then tests source support. It does not prune spurs, repair a graph, invent nodes or silently choose the largest component.

The frozen earlier 20-case experiment reported 19 source-support refusals and one skeleton loss/fragmentation. Existing evidence did not localize a definitive endpoint/rasterization cause. That matrix and the separate instrumentation were not rerun or tuned here.

Measurements, explanations and safety boundaries

Manual research arithmetic

The separate research workbench accepts explicit caliper endpoints and method evidence, validates bounds/geometry and computes affine endpoint distances. Where positive supported reference and minimum diameters exist, the arithmetic is 100 Ã— (1 âˆ’ Dmin / Dref). It is labelled unverified research arithmetic; the interface does not choose an anatomical reference or establish a clinical stenosis grade.

The formal blinded human worksheet has a stricter contract: manual diameters require endpoints and evidence; percentage and severity stay null. This deliberate distinction prevents an algorithmic proposal from becoming an independent human review or an ordinary clinical result.

Explainability actually implemented

  • Profile plots show sampled area, R1/R2 references and trigger lines. Numeric tables expose sample positions and support windows.
  • Unavailable samples create gaps rather than interpolation that hides missing evidence. Raw trigger sections are distinguished from accepted contiguous regions.
  • R3 preserves the two parent record hashes and disagreements. It is a deterministic comparison, not a third clinical opinion or an AI vote.
  • Coordinates navigate the verified source CT; model confidence, artery identity and clinical severity remain null when unsupported.
No stenosis logits or trained classifier exist. Grad-CAM cannot be honestly generated for a nonexistent stenosis prediction. Geometric support plots are not model attribution. Segmentation confidence is not calibrated clinical confidence.

Clinical export gate

Both ordinary JSON export helpers validate a detached serialized snapshot before creating a Blob, protecting nested wrappers and toJSON/getter transformations. Unbacked zero and nonzero stenosis values are rejected. Legitimate zero segmentation/evaluation metrics remain valid. Separate draft/research schemas cannot enter normal reports or training/evaluation ingestion.

The trusted clinical gate registries remain empty. The previously authorized reference-profile/0.1 display pack for Training cases 401/402/404 is reference-derived research, not approval of clinical values. Manual annotation, revisions and submission

Formal worksheet

Readers capture native-IJK lesion center, proximal and distal boundaries, minimum-caliper start/end, and reference-caliper start/end: seven landmarks. They may identify artery/segment and record manual diameters only with the required method/evidence. Null/unassessable states retain reasons; no missing value is silently replaced with zero. No lesion is auto-generated.

StageServer ruleBrowser behavior
Draft create/loadAuthenticated owner, case/patient, CT SHA, geometry and protocol binding.Source-bound worksheet; separate local JSON remains compatible within its own format.
Revision saveExpected revision must match; transaction/row locking serializes writers.409 preserves edits and requires explicit reload/resolve; no silent overwrite.
Source/session changeRevalidate actor/current source; old request cannot complete under a new session.Abort pending operations and discard stale loads/captures/exports.
Explicit submissionExpected revision + document hash + unverified acknowledgement.A clear freeze action; identical repeat is idempotent.
After submissionFrozen payload/history cannot be updated/deleted; DB triggers reinforce.Read-only submitted evidence; no implicit amendment.

Why immutable evidence matters

Without a freeze, R1 could change after R2 or the third reader saw it, destroying independence and reproducibility. Submission records retain reviewer identity, timestamps, protocol, source, payload and record hashes. Cross-reviewer reads remain denied. A stale save cannot win over a competing submitted revision.

The earlier overlay-exposed annotation draft is deliberately distinct from a blinded CT-only reading; its JSON cannot be relabelled as independent review. Normal reports refuse all draft/submission schemas. Amendments, withdrawal and reassignment require a separately versioned design and are not implemented as destructive edits.

[SRC] AnnotationDraft.jsx, ReviewAnnotationForm.jsx, annotation_drafts / review_annotations / review_submissions services; migrations 0011â€“0014 and concurrency/trigger regressions.

Third-reader adjudication and audit history

A third account can be assigned only after both independent submissions are frozen. It must differ from coordinator and initial readers and have a current, separately verified credential with scope, evidence hash, dates and revocation state. There is no self-qualification endpoint or seeded real credential.

The third reader sees both immutable parent records only through its own adjudication assignment. Its binding retains parent IDs and record hashes. It may read the verified original CT through the dedicated protected source route; an embedded third-reader CT pane is now available through the separate authenticated adjudication loader, with the original browser limits.

Correspondence and resolution

  • Correspondence refers to actual R1/R2 lesion identifiers; unknown, duplicate or contradictory references are rejected.
  • All parent lesions must be accounted for at finalization. Differing fields require explicit decisions and evidence.
  • Agreement, unresolved outcomes and ungradable/unassessed evidence remain distinguishable. Software never turns a disagreement into an automatic majority label.
  • Every save appends a version linked to its predecessor; finalization freezes the chain. Concurrent stale revisions receive conflicts.
  • Expiry/revocation removes evidence access. Both clinical and training-release authorizations remain false after finalization.

[SRC] review_adjudications.py, schemas/review_adjudication.py, ReviewAdjudications.jsx and migration 0015. History/detail pagination avoids loading all prior full payloads on every visit. Privileged administrators and credential verification remain operational trust boundaries.

What the work demonstrates

VascuAI implements a usable research engineering foundation, genuine saved segmentation/evaluation evidence, source-bound provisional profile analysis and an access-separated manual review system. The 50-case comparison establishes the observed cohort metrics under two different frozen recipes. Automated tests establish specified security, geometry, concurrency, replay and UI behavior in their recorded environments.

What it does not demonstrate

It does not establish clinically validated stenosis detection, automatic anatomical centerline completeness, qualified expert annotations, calibrated severity/confidence, stenosis Grad-CAM, independent clinical performance or completion of current release operations. Matching hashes/numeric geometry establishes identity and consistency, not anatomical registration or disease truth.

The responsible completion outcome is to preserve working, tested software while retaining explicit unavailable states. Both clinical_gate_authorized and training_release_authorized remain false throughout research and adjudication.

Document generated from actual local evidence on 24 November 2026. Source and private artifacts were preserved; no commit, push, merge, staging migration or deployment is part of this documentation deliverable.
